optional_features.description: Product safety notices and recalls: EU Safety Gate alerts, CPSC and NHTSA recalls and RASFF notifications with every revision, verbatim hazard, affected identification and corrective action, cited standards and legal acts, reviewable matches to Products identities, as-of answers and subscription monitors. No safety verdict, risk score or consumer advice; a product without an accepted match has no notice on record.

requires.reason: the feature's own entry points use these operations
notices match Products identities through reviewed GTIN, brand and model matches
cited standards resolve to catalogue editions by exact reference
cited acts (the GPSR, Regulation (EC) No 178/2002) resolve to Legal works by exact CELEX/ELI
news naming a notice number is shown as reporting, never as the notice
manufacturer and importer names link to canonical entities through identity decisions
Safety Gate, CPSC, NHTSA and RASFF sources run through the source-pack runtime
